requirements.requirement: Do not constrain plug to a horizontal-only insertion or removal path.
Lead channel and battery retention must avoid applying tensile or side loads to the mated plug.

requirements.requirement: Assembly order: open case, support PCB, align/connect unmodified battery plug, verify full seating, route original leads, seat battery/insulation, close cover.
